high.title: Middle East War Triggers Imported Inflation - Transportation, Tourism, Dining, Automotive, Retail All Rise
high.summary:
The US-Iran conflict has pushed up oil prices, freight costs, and raw material prices, triggering broad-based imported inflation pressures from top to bottom. Six major sectors including transportation, tourism, automotive, paper, packaging materials, and agriculture are experiencing price increases. Companies are transferring costs comprehensively, and consumers will face pressure across all terminal consumption from air tickets, tourism, car purchases to daily shopping. 

This development is critical for Taiwan's Central Bank monetary policy as imported inflation could force the CBC to reconsider interest rate cuts. Rising energy and raw material costs will impact corporate margins across sectors and potentially slow economic growth. For life insurers, higher inflation expectations could benefit long-term investment returns but may pressure near-term operating costs and claims expenses.

high.title: ChatGPT to Upgrade Computing Power with Estimated 40% Increase - Benefiting Hon Hai, Quanta, Wistron
high.summary:
OpenAI is reportedly releasing the new GPT 6.0 model, integrating chatbot, web browser, and Codex functions with computing power estimated to surge 40%. This drives a new wave of computing demand. Legal entities are optimistic about AI server supply chain companies Hon Hai (2317), Quanta (2382), and Wistron (3231) gaining momentum.

GPT 6.0 is expected to achieve simultaneous text, audio, image, and video generation while fully integrating ChatGPT, Codex, and Atlas browser applications. Hon Hai has secured orders from L6 to L11 levels with full order momentum extending to 2027. The company's Q1 2026 revenue reached NT$2.129 trillion, marking the strongest first quarter in history with 29.7% year-over-year growth.

high.title: Taiwan Dollar Exchange Rate
high.summary: The Taiwan dollar closed at NT$31.967 against the US dollar on April 7, appreciating 0.5 cents from the previous trading day's close of NT$31.972. This slight strengthening occurs amid Middle East tensions and reflects market dynamics important for foreign investors and Taiwan's export competitiveness.

high.title: Foreign Investors Counter-Trend Buying Anti-Drop Stocks - Taiwan Opto, Giantec Expected to Lead Retaliatory Rebound
high.summary:
Despite Middle East conflicts and rising oil prices, foreign investors heavily sold NT$968.2 billion in Taiwan stocks in March and maintained selling last week. However, they counter-trend bought Taiwan Opto (6274), Giantec, and others, which may become anti-drop leaders or spearhead retaliatory rebounds in April.

Foreign investors continue buying over NT$3 billion in April across 14 stocks including Taiwan Opto, Giantec, PCB manufacturers, and semiconductor companies. Electronic stocks, especially AI-related ones, remain foreign investors' counter-trend focus as war doesn't harm AI industry development trends. This selective buying pattern indicates foreign confidence in specific technology sectors despite broader market concerns.

medium.title: Trump: Iran Must "Fully, Immediately and Safely" Reopen Strait of Hormuz or Face Two-Week Suspension of Attacks
medium.summary: US President Trump announced conditional suspension of bombing Iran for two weeks, calling it a "bilateral ceasefire" contingent on Iran fully reopening the Strait of Hormuz. Trump cited Pakistan's mediation request and significant progress toward long-term peace negotiations with Iran's 10-point proposal as basis for this decision.

medium.title: Memory Sector March Revenue Strong - Macronix Near 51-Month High, ADATA and TeamGroup Hit New Records
medium.summary: Memory sector showed robust March performance with Macronix (2337) revenue reaching NT$4.422 billion, up 45.9% monthly and 96.5% yearly - a near 51-month high. ADATA (3260) and TeamGroup (4967) both set new monthly records at NT$10.537 billion and NT$4.916 billion respectively, driven by strong AI demand and memory price increases.

medium.title: Broadcom, Google, and Anthropic Strategic Three-Way Cooperation - TSMC Advanced Process Demand Explosion
medium.summary: Broadcom announced expanded strategic cooperation with Anthropic and Google, jointly providing TPU computing power and producing future TPU versions for Google through 2031. This strengthens Broadcom's ASIC market position and benefits foundry partner TSMC (2330) with increased advanced process demand.

medium.title: Stock King Aspeed Revenue Hits Two New Highs - Server BMC Shipment Success
medium.summary: Aspeed (5274) benefited from increased AI server BMC shipments, with March revenue reaching NT$1.235 billion - five consecutive months of new highs, up 22.2% monthly and 63.6% yearly. Q1 revenue of NT$3.14 billion exceeded expectations and marked four consecutive quarters of records.

medium.title: Taiwan Stock Market Close - Up 657.39 Points to 33,229.82, TSMC Closes at 1,860 Yuan Up 2.76%
medium.summary: Taiwan stocks surged 657.39 points or 2.01% to close at 33,229.82 points on April 7. TSMC (2330) gained NT$50 to NT$1,860, up 2.76%. Trading volume was NT$564.3 billion with 561 gainers versus 478 decliners.
